opening.argument: The description identifies the central activity: a streamer stays on the phone with reported computer scammers to waste their time. That is a humorous scam-baiting premise, not a request for viewers to use the callers' services. Payment-confirmation and bank-notification questions appear in the recorded call, but the available evidence does not establish that the creator makes or endorses those requests. The burner-card caption suggests a detail of the interaction; it does not establish that a card or transaction existed, or that viewers were asked to participate. The observable conduct supports an entertainment and scam-baiting reading without treating dialogue from the call as the creator's own solicitation.
